maddeler.e:
تقترضوا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِضُوا (taqtariḍū) /taq.ta.ri.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# تُقْتَرَضُوا (tuqtaraḍū) /tuq.ta.ra.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
